race.comment: LANE CHANGER (7) is former Victorian who will be better for two local outings and is sure to find this easier than what she faced down south. Right in this contest. PLAYFUL PUZZLE (8) got a well-deserved win at Moree last time and will have derived some confidence from that victory. Top-three credentials. ABRAHAM (1) has a win and a placing from three attempts over this mile journey and gets some weight relief with the 1.5kg claim. In the mix. BOLE LE (2) is usually thereabouts and looks one for the multiples.
